title: Sequoia says it's closing its London office after six years and consolidating operations back to the Bay Area, as it doesn't "see the need for a local presence" (Mike Butcher/Pathfounders)
summary: Mike Butcher / Pathfounders: Sequoia says it's closing its London office after six years and consolidating operations back to the Bay Area, as it doesn't “see the need for a local presence” — US venture capital giant Sequoia Capital is closing its London office, ending the six-run of a significant European presence …
